intents.name: greeting
intents.reply: Hello! 👋 Welcome to LearnBridge. How can I help you today? You can ask about registration, books, prices or support.

intents.name: registration
intents.reply: You can register on LearnBridge for free! Visit https://learnbridge.ng to create your account.

intents.name: pricing

intents.name: support
intents.reply: Please describe the issue you're experiencing. A human will follow up when available.
